instruction: I find the italic formatting in this document unnecessary and it makes reading harder for me. Can you remove all italic formatting from the document, changing all italicized text to normal (non-italic) formatting?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing all italic formatting from the document. Evaluator checks that no text has italic formatting remaining. Verified document currently has 21 italic runs that need to be changed to normal formatting.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction: all italic formatting must be removed from the document
Metric logic is comprehensive: iterates through all paragraphs and runs to check for italic property
Proper data flow: get_vm_file retrieves document, metric checks all text runs for italic formatting
Complete coverage: checks ALL text runs in document, not just a subset
Robust implementation: handles errors gracefully, checks non-empty text to avoid false positives from empty italic runs
Correct postconfig: activates window and saves document with Ctrl+S to ensure modified state is persisted
Binary verification matches binary task: returns 1.0 if no italic found, 0.0 if any italic remains
Getter can successfully access the document state after task completion
